title: Rosalind and the Signal
author: Bram Halloran
blurb: Elodie Whitlock, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
